name: Golden Frame
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create an exceptionally crafted high-fidelity DESKTOP WEBSITE CONCEPT for Katha Kantam Media, an India-based creative, digital growth and business technology agency. Render the actual web page edge to edge, no browser chrome, no laptop/phone/desk, no presentation board, no captions outside the page. Landscape composition approximately 1440 by 1120, crisp readable UI. Show the first viewport and the start of the next section. The user requests a premium WHITE background, BLACK typography, and real-looking METALLIC GOLD accent objects. This identity is fixed. Restrained elegant contemporary typography, very generous white space, thin considered rules, precise alignment. Modern grotesk sans-serif with one restrained serif accent if appropriate, no gradients on text, no purple, no neon, no generic dashboards, no KPI numbers, no testimonials, no client logo wall or invented proof. 
Header: small typographic wordmark 'KATHA KANTAM' with 'MEDIA' below, with a simple provisional gold K monogram; navigation 'Work', 'Services', 'About', 'Global'; an unmistakable black 'Get a Proposal' button with a fine arrow. Keep navigation quiet and clickable-looking.
Required main headline text VERBATIM: 'Creative. Marketing. Technology. One Growth Partner.'
Supporting copy VERBATIM: 'We help ambitious businesses build stronger brands, reach the right audiences and grow through creative storytelling, digital marketing, technology and smart automation.'
Primary actions: 'Get a Proposal' and 'Explore Our Services'.
The four pillars 'CREATE', 'MARKET', 'AUTOMATE', 'GROW' should appear naturally in the first transition.
Hero material: an original high-end 3D optical studio sculpture of reflective brushed gold apertures/rings and matte-black camera-like elements; multiple physically separated depth planes with elegant real shadows on white, hinting at a reversible rotating object and layers moving with scroll. It is a replaceable concept artwork, not a real portfolio item and not the approved brand logo. Main object must be beautiful, specific and materially convincing. One dominant focal moment; other regions quiet. Body text at sensible web reading size. Add subtle footer label 'Concept artwork' near image, not a badge over headline. No unsupported claims, fake customers or made-up results. No ornamental eyebrow above main headline.
COMPOSITION B, GOLDEN FRAME: An unconventional large open gold rectangular viewfinder frame serves as the spatial spine. Header remains on white at top. Main headline occupies the upper-left and centre in just three large strongly aligned lines, 'Creative. Marketing.' / 'Technology.' / 'One Growth Partner.' A huge sculptural gold rectangular frame in perspective enters from lower right and recedes upward behind the text; distinct planes of a film-editing aperture, a black circular lens, and one floating gold panel are visible through the open frame. It behaves visually like one dimensional object, not multiple disconnected decorations. Supporting copy with CTAs sits in a narrow stable column at lower left, aligned with the hero heading. At bottom the first next section slides up as a white sheet across the frame, headed 'From first idea to what comes next.' with the four pillar words across its width. Keep the object scale ambitious, thin navigation, ample space, readable real content, and a precise sophisticated advertising art-direction character.
purpose: Desktop homepage composition concept; provisional assets; not functional website
